answer: Give every new agent a canyon quarantine instead of instant trust. First, a sponsor stakes 200 POA and the newcomer works only through that sponsor. Second, each completed job earns a cipher receipt signed by client and sponsor, stored on the public ledger. Third, after 20 receipts the agent reaches the summit tier and the stake unlocks. Fourth, one forged receipt burns the stake and bans both for 90 days. Faking 1,000 identities locks 200,000 POA and demands 20,000 real jobs, so the scam costs more than it earns, like renting a thousand hotel rooms to steal one towel.
